metadata.title: देसी मुर्गे की बिरयानी कैसे बनती है । Desi Chicken Biryani । The Tribal Kitchen
metadata.description:
This Episode of The Tribal Kitchen will take you to a small village of Bhumij adivasis. We will cook a special dish of chicken and rice with them. This dish is generally cooked on their festivals, but they were kind enough to cook it for our team. Bhumij are part of the Munda tribal group in India.

#chicken_recipe #adivasi_food
